status: Necessary deterministic correction; original manuscript CI/fold implementation not located. OLS points, samples and weights unchanged.
required_inputs_note: The third-party harmonized Plot_dataset.dta is an author-supplied input and is not redistributed. Repository inputs are frozen_profiles.csv and benchmark_predictions.csv. No household identifier is written to outputs; CV assignments use only source row indices and country.

methods.survey_point_model: Unpenalized weighted least squares with country fixed effects; eight traits; household pw applied to plot rows.
methods.ensemble_point_model: Same traits/country fixed effects, unweighted provider-ensemble predictions.
methods.adoption: Missing inorganic-fertilizer responses coded zero; Ethiopia requires inorganic_fertilizer=1 and positive nitrogen_kg, matching frozen definition.
methods.survey_primary_cluster: country x known EA; missing EA uses country x household, retaining all seasons/plots of each household.
methods.bootstrap: With replacement at cluster/profile level within each country; same supplied analysis weights unchanged; percentile 2.5/97.5 intervals; 500 survey/2000 ensemble draws.
methods.cv: Survey: 5-fold shuffled GroupKFold at cluster level. Ensemble: 10-fold shuffled KFold at profile level. R2=1 - heldout weighted full-model SSE / heldout weighted SSE of country-only model fit in each training fold.
methods.country_models: Same eight traits plus intercept, separately by country; primary cluster/profile bootstrap and seed as pooled models.
methods.stress_test: All rows with unknown EA in each country placed in one artificial cluster; diagnostic sensitivity only, neither a recovered EA nor a conservative uncertainty bound.
methods.limitation: Unknown-EA fallback covers dependence within households, not residual dependence between different households from the same unknown EA. Uganda missing-EA records comprise 61.3% of its analysis weight. Intervals do not represent complete survey-design uncertainty.
